lead: South Dakota plumbing deals with deep cold, hard water and lots of private wells. PipeMend sends licensed local plumbers from Sioux Falls to Rapid City.
risk: frozen pipes, hard water scale and well systems
risk_short: frozen pipes, hard water and wells
why: South Dakota winters are long and cold, so water lines must be buried deep, and exposed lines freeze. Water is hard in much of the state.
Many rural homes rely on private wells and septic systems. The South Dakota State Plumbing Commission licenses plumbers.
tips: Keep your softener supplied with salt.
areas: Calls come from Sioux Falls, Rapid City, Aberdeen, Brookings, Watertown, Mitchell and rural South Dakota.

faq.q: Who licenses plumbers in South Dakota?
faq.a: The South Dakota State Plumbing Commission licenses plumbers. Check the license before work starts.
